originalTitle: Trump again rebukes Jeanine Pirro over reflecting pool ‘vandalism’ case
summary: President attacks ‘terrible mistake’ of US attorney, who said in court filing damage stemmed from botched renovation
content: Donald Trump has doubled down on his criticism of Jeanine Pirro after the US attorney for the District of Columbia publicly challenged his claims that vandals had damaged the recently renovated Lincoln Memorial reflecting pool. “She said there was no vandalism. There was tremendous vandalism,” Trump told NBC News on Thursday. “So, she made a terrible mistake. I don’t understand why she did such a stupid thing.” On Friday, Pirro – a former Fox News host and longtime Trump ally who he handpicked to serve as the top prosecutor for the nation’s capital – moved to dismiss vandalism charges against a former Olympian and three others in connection with incidents at the reflecting pool. In a 20-page court filing, Pirro’s office wrote that the damage to the concrete-bottomed tourist attraction was the result of a “botched” renovation – “not vandalism”. Asked on Thursday whether he would consider replacing Pirro, Trump told NBC: “I think she made a terrible decision. That doesn’t mean change.” The comments came after a reportedly heated Oval Office meeting on Monday with Trump, Pirro, and interior secretary Doug Burgum. According to the New York Times, Pirro accused Burgum of misleading the president about the rushed renovation by a vendor awarded a no-bid contract from the interior department. Later that evening, Trump told reporters he had not “made a determination” yet as to whether Pirro would be ousted. The White House did not immediately reply to a request for comment. Earlier this week, Trump accused Pirro of having “folded like an umbrella” after the justice department dismissed the case against David Hearn, a former Olympic canoeist who faced a felony property destruction charge that carried a potential sentence of up to 10 years in prison and a $1,000 fine for the act of having touched a chunk of the pool’s newly peeled coating. Hearn, 67, pleaded not guilty. In a statement after the charges were dropped, Hearn’s lawyers said the case should never have been brought, and argued that its dismissal “does not erase the abuse of government power in arresting and charging a patriotic American who did nothing wrong”. “The administration owes Mr Hearn an apology,” they said. Hearn is one of seven people who was charged in connection with what Trump claimed were attempts to vandalize the $15m renovation of the reflecting pool that has been plagued by problems the justice department said was “the result of flawed installation by the contractor”. “Frankly, I think she choked,” Trump said from the Oval Office on Monday. An attorney for Hearn has since said that “all options are on table” for legal action. Those include “civil suits, bar referrals for the prosecutors involved, request for sanctions, and reimbursement of attorneys’ fees and expenses,” Hearn’s attorney Steven Levin said on Tuesday.
chineseTitle: 特朗普再次斥责珍妮·皮罗反映泳池“破坏公物”案
chineseSummary: 总统攻击美国检察官的“可怕错误”，后者在法庭文件中表示，损害源于拙劣的装修
chineseContent: 在美国哥伦比亚特区检察官公开质疑唐纳德·特朗普关于破坏者破坏了最近翻修的林肯纪念堂倒影池的说法后，唐纳德·特朗普加大了对珍妮·皮罗的批评力度。 “她说没有发生故意破坏行为。但发生了严重的破坏行为，”特朗普周四对美国全国广播公司新闻 (NBC News) 表示。 “所以，她犯了一个可怕的错误。我不明白她为什么要做这么蠢的事。”周五，前福克斯新闻主持人、特朗普的长期盟友皮罗（Pirro）提出驳回对一名前奥运选手和其他三人因倒影池事件有关的破坏公物指控。在一份长达 20 页的法庭文件中，皮罗的办公室写道，这座混凝土底部的旅游景点受到的损坏是由于“拙劣”的翻修造成的，“而不是故意破坏”。周四，当被问及是否会考虑取代皮罗时，特朗普告诉 NBC：“我认为她做出了一个糟糕的决定。这并不意味着改变。”据报道，特朗普周一在椭圆形办公室与特朗普、皮罗和内政部长道格·布尔古姆举行了激烈的会议后发表了上述言论。据《纽约时报》报道，皮罗指责布尔古姆在一家获得内政部无投标合同的供应商仓促翻修一事上误导了总统。当天晚上晚些时候，特朗普告诉记者，他尚未“决定”皮罗是否会被赶下台。白宫没有立即回复置评请求。本周早些时候，特朗普指责皮罗“像雨伞一样折叠起来”，此前司法部驳回了针对前奥运皮划艇运动员戴维·赫恩的案件，他面临破坏财产重罪指控，可能被判处最高 10 年监禁和 1000 美元罚款。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
